## Checks

- [ ] `python3 tools/validate_submission.py submissions/<path>/submission.json` passes
- [ ] File contains no API key, token or seed value
- [ ] All attempts reported, including retries and discarded runs
- [ ] Large logs and videos linked to my own storage, with digests, not committed here
- [ ] `status` left as `community_reported` (only the organizers set `officially_evaluated`)
